digest.component_or_area: LLM framework / structured output and cache instrumentation
propositions: Live direct-Anthropic two-call structured-output canary (cache write then read) succeeds with typed completion_verdict result and records identical cache hit on call 2 matching the write from call 1.
Live Bedrock two-call structured-output canary (same write-then-read sequence) succeeds with typed result and exhibits matching cache behavior, confirming prompt caching works on both providers.

Observed accounting (requests, input_tokens, cache_write_tokens, cache_read_tokens) matches the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md for the one-operation happy path with no output repair or transport retry.

Complete-or-omit projection branch was directly instrumented and recorded exactly once per call with 1 message in, 1 kept, 0 omitted on both providers, confirming the first response was well-formed and the omit branch was not exercised.
